description.value:
A thrown grenade (no launcher) that hovers over its square and broadcasts for 5 Rounds in a 10×10m area. Any drone not directly controlled that starts its Turn in the area or crosses it must beat DV21 Concentration (with its Combat Number) or go after the lure ahead of anyone who hasn't attacked it since its last Turn. Then it drops, Destroyed Beyond Repair.

Item Compendium (2070) • Ammo & Explosives
